as_told.title: Robertson Panel's secret recommendations to debunk, detect and track

plain: Karl Nell, a retired US Army officer, says declassified documents show that the Robertson Panel, a group of scientists convened by the CIA in 1953, effectively decided the government should debunk UFOs. According to him, the aim was to mislead the public and even to infiltrate the groups that studied the subject.
